verdict.rationale: Copilot's cloud/background agents and coding agent sessions are tracked via a centralized control page and can be launched/reviewed from GitHub.com, implying you could start a task from one machine and check/continue it from a browser on another device (github-copilot-docs-6, docs-8, docs-14, docs-15). However, there's no explicit first-party statement describing seamless cross-device handoff, no mention of mobile/browser parity for the interactive IDE experience, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit cross-device continuity documentation, mobile/web parity details, and independent verification of resuming a task from a different device.
